scope.plus: all standalone legal/attribution files and tools/system_libs.py when present

algorithm: Retain complete C-style block/contiguous line legal comments; retain complete original file whenever a legal marker lies outside a retained comment or the member is a standalone legal/attribution file. UTF-8 bytes are unmodified; explicitly marked UTF-16 text retains original bytes as Base64 plus a lossless UTF-8 whole-file projection, whose offsets are labelled. Exact retained-byte deduplication only. Verify every selected tar member against its pinned Git blob; every declared member has a disposition.
